cells.gaps: No source found says a facility with GPUs or AI accelerators is in service in Angola: GO4AI runs on Angola Cables' global infrastructure and its GPUs are not placed in the country.
cells.note: Fact 2026-11-26: Angola Cables launched GO4AI on 12 June 2026, on-demand GPUs for AI training and inference billed in kwanzas (AGO-004), so AI computing is in service. The source places the GPUs on the company's global infrastructure, not in Angola, so not 4.
